这是 ComfyUI 中 AnimateDiff 的 AnimateLCM Vid2Vid 工作流程。

使用此工作流程，使用 ControlNet、Prompting 和 IPAdapter 从视频源输入创建引人入胜的 AI 视频！

注意：在 IPAdapter 中，请下载此文件并将其放置在 comfyui\clip_vision 目录中。这是针对“LOAD Clip Vision”节点的。

https://drive.google.com/file/d/13KXx6u9JpHnWdemhqswRQJhVqThEE-7q/view?usp=sharing

你可以在此处找到“LOAD IPAdapter Model”节点的 IPAdapter Plus 1.5 模型。

https://github.com/cubiq/ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus

如果您不想升级，请绕过右下角的所有升级组。

应该是这样:)

请在您使用工作流程制作的任何内容中标记我，我将在我的社交媒体上分享！

Instagram 上的 @jboogx.creative 和 @hellocivitai
---------------------------------------------
免责声明：这不适合初学者。如果您是初学者，请从此处链接的@Inner_Reflections_Ai vid2vid 工作流程开始：

https://civitai.com/articles/2379/guide-comfyui-animatediff-guideworkflows-including-prompt-scheduling-an-inner-reflections-guide

之后由于很多请求，我决定公开分享我在流中使用的这个工作流程。这能够实现以下功能......

-------------------------------------------------

  1. Vid2Vid + 控制网络 - 当您不想使用这些节点时，请绕过它们并添加您需要的任何 CN 和预处理器。其中包括的是我的首选。

  2. 高分辨率修复放大-当测试期间不进行升级时，请确保绕过每个升级组和非常潜在的升级视频组合节点。

  3. 多图像 IPAdapter 集成 -不要绕过这些节点，否则事情会崩溃。在最底部的每个 IPAdapter 图像节点中插入图像，如果不使用 IPAdapter 作为样式或图像参考，只需将权重和强度降低为零即可。这基本上会将其关闭。

  4. QR 码幻觉渲染 -为此，请使用黑白 Alpha 作为输入视频，并使用 QR Code Monster 作为唯一的 ControlNet。

    -------------------------------------------------

这是基于 Vid2Vid 发布的基本工作流程构建的@Inner_Reflections_AI通过 Civitai 文章。以下才华横溢的艺术家（他们的 Instagram 账号）是帮助我完成此工作流程各个部分并使其达到目的的贡献者......

可能需要下载一些节点，所有这些都应该可以通过 Comfy 管理器访问（我认为）。您可以根据当前工作的需要绕过任意数量的 LoRA、ControlNet 和升级。拥有节点的中级到高级知识将帮助您减轻在打开和关闭事物时可能遇到的任何错误，如果您是初学者，我建议您从@Inner_Reflections_AI基本的 Vid2Vid 工作流程，因为这是我最初能够理解 Comfy 的唯一方式。

o.en:
This is an AnimateLCM Vid2Vid workflow for AnimateDiff in ComfyUI.

Use this workflow to create captivating AI videos from video source inputs using ControlNets, Prompting, and the IPAdapter!

NOTE:In the IPAdapter, please download and place this file in your comfyui\clip_vision directory. This is for the 'LOAD Clip Vision' node.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/13KXx6u9JpHnWdemhqswRQJhVqThEE-7q/view?usp=sharing

Youcan find the IPAdapter Plus 1.5 model for the 'LOAD IPAdapter Model' node here.

https://github.com/cubiq/ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus

If you don't want to upscale, then bypass all Upscale groups on the bottom right.

That should be it :)

Please tag me in anything you make using the workflow and I will share on my social!

@jboogx.creative as well as @hellocivitai on Instagram
---------------------------------------------
DISCLAIMER: This is NOT beginner friendly. If you are a beginner, start with @Inner_Reflections_Ai vid2vid workflow that is linked here:

https://civitai.com/articles/2379/guide-comfyui-animatediff-guideworkflows-including-prompt-scheduling-an-inner-reflections-guide

Aftermany requests, I have decided to share this workflow that I use on my streams publicly. This is capable of the following....

-------------------------------------------------

  1. Vid2Vid + Control Nets - Bypass these nodes when you don't want to use them and add any CN and preprocessors you need. The one's included are my go to's.

  2. High Res Fix Upscaling-When not Upscaling during testing, make sure to bypass every upscaling group and the very latent upscale video combine node.

  3. Multiple Image IPAdapter Integration -Do NOT bypass these nodes or things will break. Insert an image in each of the IPAdapter Image nodes on the very bottom and whjen not using the IPAdapter as a style or image reference, simply turn the weight and strength down to zero. This will essentially turn it off.

  4. QR Code Illusion Renders -To do this, use a black and white alpha as your input video and use QR Code Monster as your only ControlNet.

    -------------------------------------------------

This was built off of the base Vid2Vid workflow that was released by@Inner_Reflections_AIvia the Civitai Article. The contributors to helping me with various parts of this workflow and getting it to the point its at are the following talented artists (their Instagram handles)...

@lightnlense

@pxl.pshr

@machine.delusions

@cerspense

@midjourneyman

@patchesflows

@dotsimulate

Without their help, this would not have provided the many hours of video making enjoyment it has for me. I am not the most technically gifted person in this, so any input from the community or tweaks to further improve upon this would be greatly appreciated (that's really why I want to share it now)

There may be some node downloading needed, all of which should be accessible via the Comfy manager (I think). You can bypass any number of the LoRAs, ControlNets, and Upscaling as you need for what you are currently working on. Having intermediate to advanced knowledge of the nodes will help you mitigate with any of the errors you may get as you're turning things on and off, if you're a total beginner, I would recommend starting with@Inner_Reflections_AIbase Vid2Vid workflow as it was the only way I was able to understand Comfy in the first place.

The zip file includes both a workflow .json file as well as a png that you can simply drop into your ComfyUI workspace to load everything. Be prepared to download a lot of Nodes via the ComfyUI manager.

Any issues or questions, I will be more than happy to attempt to help when I am free to do so 🙂

If you make cool things with this, I would love for you to tag me on IG so I can share your creations. Also, a follow is greatly appreciated if you extract any value from this.If you use it and like it? Leave me a dope review and throw me some stars!

@jboogx.creative
